title: OCO index place code Ma5 / Ma5b / Ma5c (Regina caeli)
prompt: Ma1-Ma4 (with hour C) are the four Marian antiphons after Compline (Alma, Ave Regina, Salve, Sub tuum) and load to COMPLINE.antMar. Ma5/Ma5b/Ma5c are three Regina caeli settings, p696, indexed with day TP and hour V (not C). Note the legend's 'Ma' = Magnificat anno A, a different code. 3 index row(s). Examples: #2612 'Regina cæli' TP|V|Ma5 p696; #2613 'Regina cæli' TP|V|Ma5b p696; #2614 'Regina cæli' TP|V|Ma5c p696. Legend OCO pp1210-1213 does not define this code. Rows with it are held: the mapper (oco/oco_sigla.py) gives no lit_part_sources target, so identity can load but the assignment waits. Answer = what the code means and where the chant goes (service.part, epoch, option_txt). Carry-out: add the rule to oco_sigla.py, re-run oco/load_oco_lps.py, record it in oco/specs/README.md 'User rulings'.

options.label: Compline Marian antiphon, TP
options.detail: hour V is a misprint for C: COMPLINE.antMar on PASC; Ma5 option 1, Ma5b/Ma5c further options ('Alia melodia').

options.label: also after Vespers
options.detail: as above, plus VESPERS.antMar (needs a new service_part — schema change).
